description: Arpeggiator: it plays the notes held at its polyphonic pitch input in an order and a rhythm chosen by two knobs

params.text: Chooses the rhythm: UNF spreads the hits evenly, EUC spreads them as a Euclidean pattern, PRM puts them on prime-numbered pulses, WBE on the weak beats, SBE on the strong beats and RND at random
Chooses the order the held notes are played in: UPP upwards, DWN downwards, TCE from the ends towards the centre, FCE from the centre towards the ends and RND at random
Sets how many octaves the arpeggio climbs through, one to three
Sets how many of the pulses carry a note, as a percentage; it changes nothing under the PRM rhythm
Sets the length of the gate output as a percentage of the gap between clock pulses

inputs.text: Each rising edge above 1V is one pulse of the arpeggio
Sets the density knob directly from 0 to 5V, in steps, and moves the knob with it; the knob cannot be turned while a cable is in
Sets the gate length knob directly from 0 to 5V, in steps, and moves the knob with it; the knob cannot be turned while a cable is in
Sets the octaves knob directly from 0 to 5V, in steps, and moves the knob with it; the knob cannot be turned while a cable is in
The notes to arpeggiate, one per channel, at 1V per octave
A rising edge above 2V returns the arpeggio to its first pulse
Sets the rhythm knob directly from 0 to 5V, in steps, and moves the knob with it; the knob cannot be turned while a cable is in
Sets the melody knob directly from 0 to 5V, in steps, and moves the knob with it; the knob cannot be turned while a cable is in

outputs.text: 10V for the share of the clock interval the gate length knob sets
The note being played, one at a time, at 1V per octave
A 1ms pulse at 10V on each note

notes: nothing is played until a clock is patched to clck and at least one note is held at the 1v/o input; the arpeggio is built from the channels present on that input
the pitch input and the clock should come through chains of the same length, or the two arrive a sample or more apart and the arpeggio picks up the wrong notes
menu: Pulses per quarter: 2 PPQN, 3 PPQN, 4 PPQN, 5 PPQN, 6 PPQN — sets how many pulses of the incoming clock make one beat
Pulses per quarter factor: X1, X2, X3 — multiplies the pulses-per-quarter setting
